form.label: UserParameter executions
form.description: Investigate structured execution evidence collected through the Zabbix API.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: Investigate structured execution evidence collected through the Zabbix API.

html.p: Opt-in: deploy the wrapper or a compatible producer, collect its log with Zabbix, then select userparameters and the log item IDs in Setup. Missing end records are incomplete evidence, not proof of a running process. Command output and arguments are omitted. Evidence is producer-reported; OS auditing is needed for independent descendant-process coverage.

search.query: | tstats dc(UserParameter.invocation_id) AS invocations FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.UserParameter WHERE UserParameter.instance=$instance|s$ UserParameter.status=success

| tstats dc(UserParameter.invocation_id) AS invocations FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.UserParameter WHERE UserParameter.instance=$instance|s$ (UserParameter.status=failure OR UserParameter.status=timeout OR UserParameter.status=spawn_failed OR UserParameter.status=interrupted)
| tstats dc(UserParameter.event_uid) AS records FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.UserParameter WHERE UserParameter.instance=$instance|s$ UserParameter.parse_status=invalid

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:userparameter parse_status=valid | `zabbix_userparameter_correlation` | sort -last_seen | convert ctime(last_seen) | table last_seen dest userparameter_key reported_status evidence_state exit_code duration_ms invocation_id

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:userparameter phase=end parse_status=valid | dedup instance hostid itemid invocation_id phase | stats count median(duration_ms) AS median_ms perc95(duration_ms) AS p95_ms by instance dest userparameter_key
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:userparameter parse_status=invalid | dedup event_uid | table _time instance dest itemid error
